queries_run: Walgreens credit rating downgrade 2026 Sycamore private
Cencora Walgreens contract Evernorth customer 2026 guidance

findings.claim: FY2025：前十大客戶約占營收 66%；Walgreens 與 Boots 合計約 25%、Evernorth 約 13%。
findings.excerpt: Our top 10 customers, including governmental agencies and group purchasing organizations (“GPO”), represented approximately 66% of revenue in fiscal 2025. In fiscal 2025, Walgreens and Boots together accounted for approximately 25% of revenue and Evernorth Health Services accounted for approximately 13% of revenue.

findings.claim: 2025-09-30 Walgreens 與 Boots 合計占應收帳款淨額約 38%，Evernorth 約 5%；公司揭露最大客戶破產或信用失敗可能造成重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: As of September 30, 2025, our two largest trade receivable balances due from customers (Walgreens and Boots together and Evernorth Health Services) represented approximately 38% and 5% of our accounts receivable, net.

findings.claim: 自 2026-07-01 起，部分 Walgreens 量體移出 Cencora；主供應商協議不變，占與 Walgreens 業務絕大部分。
findings.excerpt: The prime vendor agreement, which remains unchanged, constitutes the vast majority of the Company's business with Walgreens.

findings.claim: Walgreens 於 2025-08-28 被 Sycamore 私有化，評等機構撤銷評等；私有化前 S&P 為 BB- 並列負面 CreditWatch。查無 2026 年新降評。

customer_concentration_credit.note: Evernorth 2026 信用事件查無來源。
